translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Gi dwol mar “Ondanyo.” Maskil

content.text: Chunya bedo mamor gi wer mamit
e kinde mawero Zaburi maga ne Ruoth;
kendo lewa chalo kalamb jandiko mongʼith.
In ema iber moloyo chwo mamoko
kendo dhogi owir gi ngʼwono,
nikech Nyasaye osegwedhi nyaka chiengʼ.
Twe liganglani e bathi, yaye ngʼat maratego;
rwakri gi ler kod duongʼ.
E duongʼni nyisri ayanga kaka jalocho
mochungʼ ni adiera gi muolo kod tim makare;
lweti ma korachwich mondo onyis timbeni miwuoro.
Aserni mabitho mondo ochwo chunje mag wasik ruoth;
ogendini mondo opodh piny e bwoyi.
Lochni nosik nyaka chiengʼ, yaye Nyasaye;
kendo tim makare ema nobed kaka ludh loch e pinyruodhi.
Ihero tim makare to imon gi timbe maricho;
emomiyo Nyasaye, ma Nyasachi,
osetingʼi malo moyombo jowadu nikech osewiri gi mo mamiyi mor.
Lepi maboyo duto dungʼ tik mane-mane gi poda kod kasia;
moa e ute ruodhi molichi gi lak liech.
Wende mindito gi gig wer miyi mor.
Nyi ruodhi ni e kanyakla mag mondi moluor;
mikach ruoth ni e bathi korachwich korwakore gi dhahabu mogol Ofir.
Winji nyara, bed mos, kendo chik iti:
Gol pachi kuom jou kaachiel gi jood wuonu monywoli.
Berni otoyo ruoth; miye duongʼ,
nikech en ruodhi.
Nyar Turo biro biro gi mich,
joma nigi mwandu biro dwaro kony kuomi.
Duongʼ olworo ruoth madhako koni gi koni e kar dakne;
law abola mare oton-oton gi dhahabu.
Omake itere ne ruoth gi law mochwe gi usi;
nyiri masilili man kode luwo bangʼe kendo ikelonegi.
Irwakogi e ot gi ilo kod mor maduongʼ;
gidonjo e dala ruoth.
Yawuoti biro kawo kar wuonegi;
ibiro ketogi ruodhi e piny duto koni gi koni.
Abiro miyo ji pari e tienge duto nyaka chiengʼ;
kuom mano ogendini biro paki mochwere manyaka chiengʼ.

footnotes.text: Maskil: en kit wer moro mane Daudi owero
